title: Nimrud Reliefs
summary: A sequence of reliefs depicting Sennacherib's siege of Lachish.
historical_context: One of the strongest archaeological depictions of a biblical-era military event.
ancient_near_east_context: The item belongs to the broader imperial, cultic, and urban world of the ancient Near East and the biblical periods reflected in the dataset.
literary_context: Provides visual evidence for the Assyrian siege context behind Judah's crisis.
covenantal_significance: Nimrud Reliefs helps anchor biblical claims in historical reality while reminding readers that archaeology supports rather than replaces interpretation.
interpretive_notes: The reliefs are explicit about the siege, but they still represent Assyrian royal perspective.
Use the item as context for the biblical text, not as a shortcut around it.
